_readme: Core business facts. Anything set to null renders on the site as a visible [placeholder] and is listed in README > Before launch.
name: F.Y.C. / N.Y.C.
description: Wine bar and kitchen in Flatiron, NYC, on the Chelsea border. Mostly biodynamic, small-production wines, spirit-specific cocktails and seasonal global comfort food. Walk-ins always welcome.
founders: A collective of 5 friends that have about 100 years of NYC restaurant experience between us.

address.landmarks: Near Union Square and Madison Square Park

booking._readme: provider: 'resy' or 'opentable'. Resy is primary (Q1, confirmed Oct 2026). Add Resy's venue ID and widget API key to embed the widget; until both are set the drawer shows direct links.
policy: Tables for 2–4 guests are held for 2 hours; 5–6 guests, 2.5 hours.
Patio tables are booked weather permitting.

analytics._readme: Paste the GA4 Measurement ID (G-XXXXXXX). Empty = analytics off.

forms._readme: Cloudflare Turnstile site key (public). The secret goes in the TURNSTILE_SECRET_KEY environment variable.

hero._readme: Swap /public/video/hero-loop.mp4 (H.264) and hero-loop.webm (VP9) for the real bartender loop (5–8s, muted, each under 2MB). The current files are the first 6 seconds of the old site's house film (bartender sequence). The full film is /public/video/fyc-film.mp4 on /our-story.

voice.kidsTable: Come see what being part of the Family is all about. We won't make you sit at the kid's table.
voice.lights: Lower the lights, turn the music up, have another glass, and feel free to dance in your chair.
voice.cookout: Want the invite to the family cookout?
